cases.name: direct_gt
cases.why: The reading is compared directly (gt).

cases.name: direct_gte
cases.why: The reading is compared directly (gte).

cases.name: direct_lt
cases.why: The reading is compared directly (lt).

cases.name: direct_lte
cases.why: The reading is compared directly (lte).

cases.name: direct_eq
cases.why: The reading is compared directly (eq).

cases.name: window_average
cases.why: A average over a 60 second window is compared.

cases.name: window_min
cases.why: A min over a 60 second window is compared.

cases.name: window_max
cases.why: A max over a 60 second window is compared.

cases.name: held
cases.why: The condition must hold for 300 seconds.

cases.name: held_twice
cases.why: Two hold steps add up.

cases.name: cooldown
cases.why: A cooldown passes the condition through.

cases.name: combined_and
cases.why: Two conditions on two devices joined with AND.

cases.name: combined_or
cases.why: Two conditions on two devices joined with OR.

cases.name: combined_then_held
cases.why: A hold after the conditions are combined applies to each.

cases.name: inverted
cases.why: The alert is on the false branch, so it is raised when the comparison is not met.

cases.name: true_branch
cases.why: The true branch keeps the comparison as written.

cases.name: inverted_gte
cases.why: Not greater-or-equal is less-than.

cases.name: hysteresis
cases.why: Turns on above one value and off below another.

cases.name: converted
cases.why: The reading is converted from C to F before a comparison in F; the limit is given in C.

cases.name: converted_pressure
cases.why: A limit in Pa on a reading in kPa.

cases.name: converted_average
cases.why: A windowed average, then a conversion.

cases.name: two_alerts
cases.why: Two alert steps, each with its own limit.

cases.name: conversion_from_another_unit
cases.why: The conversion starts from F, but the parameter is in C.

cases.name: conversion_across_families
cases.why: Temperature cannot become pressure.

cases.name: arithmetic
cases.why: Arithmetic comes before the comparison.

cases.name: difference_of_two_readings
cases.why: Two readings are compared with each other.

cases.name: window_count
cases.why: A count over a window is not on the reading's own axis.

cases.name: window_sum
cases.why: A sum over a window is not on the reading's own axis.

cases.name: two_windows
cases.why: A window of a window.

cases.name: inverted_eq
cases.why: Not equal has no side.

cases.name: inverted_hysteresis
cases.why: On the false branch the alert depends on what happened before, not on one value.

cases.name: command_only
cases.why: The condition leads only to a command.

cases.name: event_only
cases.why: The condition leads only to an integration event.

cases.name: geofence
cases.why: A geofence has no value on a reading's axis.

cases.name: unknown_step
cases.why: A step this contract does not know.

cases.name: not_a_number
cases.why: The parameter is not numeric.

cases.name: constant_only
cases.why: A constant is compared, not a reading.

cases.name: no_alert
cases.why: No alert step at all.
